findings.pr_strategy: Guide labels 2-4 for congestion, 5-9 timing, and10-17 stronger generic optimization. Both relevant families accept2.
findings.max_fanout: Guide says ALL families, default999999; forced split may increase resources and generally need not be set. Current placement explicitly used128. A future default-value comparison is justified, benefit not established.
findings.macro_performance: Guide supports macro_congestion for all families; targets DSP/RAM congestion.
findings.pack_mode: Table lists PH2 applicability. Independent PH1P support/effect not established here; do not rely on undocumented applicability to explain gains.
findings.route_effort: routability tries more congestion-avoidance algorithms and may take longer.
findings.route_timing: off is described as prioritizing connectivity over timing during routing; not enabled here and final nonnegative setup/hold remain mandatory.
findings.parameter_persistence: report_param is described as reporting database parameters. This does not independently prove which properties this imported checkpoint carries; do not assert a missing-setting bug without actual report.
